map.VDO 和 FS 什么关系？: What is the relationship between VDO and FS?
map.VDO（垂直距离）由息止颌位减去息止颌间隙(FS，约 2~4mm)获得，是排牙与: VDO (vertical dimension of occlusion) is obtained by subtracting the freeway space (FS, about 2~4mm) from the rest position, and is the basis for tooth arrangement and restoring lower facial height.
map.→ 打开全口义齿（颌位关系）转移器工具: -> Open the complete denture (maxillomandibular relation) transfer tool
map.下颌对上颌在铰链位的最后退接触关系，是全口义齿稳定咬合的参考位，与正中颌位可能不: The last retruded contact position of the mandible against the maxilla at the hinge position; it is the reference position for stable occlusion in complete dentures and may differ from the centric relation position.
map.不能。垂直距离过低/过高都会影响咀嚼与关节，须由修复科医师结合面容、发音与肌力确: No. Both a too-low and a too-high vertical dimension affect chewing and the joint, so a prosthodontist must determine it from facial appearance, speech and muscle strength.

map.能自己定垂直距离吗？: Can I set the vertical dimension myself?
map.计算全口义齿垂直距离(VDO)、息止颌间隙(FS)与正中关系(CR)，辅助颌位记: Computes the complete denture vertical dimension (VDO), freeway space (FS) and centric relation (CR) to assist jaw relation recording and mounting.
map.：输入：息止颌位面下 1/3 = 70mm，息止颌间隙 FS = 3mm\n计算:
: inputs: lower third of the face at rest position = 70mm, freeway space FS = 3mm
calculation: normal vertical dimension VDO = rest position − FS = 70 − 3 = 67mm
note: restoring VDO relates to speech, appearance and chewing support and must be combined with facial proportions.
